objective: Reduce moving-frame latency versus the rebased exact-LOD renderer without losing more than 0.5 dB minimum foreground PSNR or worsening p95 by over 20 percent; compare the result to stock upstream main on larger inputs

ideas.title: PC contribution cutoff
ideas.claim: Cull low integrated-opacity Gaussians before sort and raster.

provenance.evidence: PC defaults use contribution=3 and are faster than our unfiltered LOD on both object scenes, but the combined-default comparison does not isolate this mechanism.
provenance.boundary: Same Apple GPU, input and viewport; approximation needs an error check.

ideas.title: PC footprint cutoff
ideas.claim: Dropping sub-two-pixel Gaussians reduces sort and raster work.

provenance.evidence: Stock minPixelSize=2; prior bee default PSNR of 18.04 dB is a warning that aggressive default filters may be unsuitable.
provenance.boundary: Can discard substantial aggregate opacity; never assume an invisible loss.

ideas.title: PC cached SH
ideas.claim: Reuse work-buffer SH until the camera-direction change justifies refreshing it.

provenance.evidence: Native PC uses a 10-degree update threshold; our existing visible-only path deliberately bypasses that cache.
provenance.boundary: Full-bank color refreshes can cost more than visible-only SH in large scenes.

components.claim: Use integrated projected opacity, not distance alone, to reject a Gaussian.
Use PC's existing contribution cutoff of 3 in the projector.
Use the Gaussian's projected footprint to reject small splats.
Use PC's two-pixel footprint cutoff in addition to contribution culling.
Evaluate visible SH after fine culling on every current view.
Use native PC work-buffer color updates at a ten-degree threshold.
Reject a new default if minimum foreground PSNR falls by over 0.5 dB or p95 increases by over 20 percent against exact LOD.

proposals.title: Contribution culling with current-view visible SH
proposals.hypothesis: Contribution=3 removes costly low-opacity splats without materially reducing the existing LOD quality.
proposals.mechanism: Set minContribution=3, retain minPixelSize=0, then evaluate SH only for surviving projected splats.
proposals.interaction: The fine cull saves both SH work and later sorting/raster work; it does not add a full-bank color refresh.
proposals.baseline: Rebased exact LOD 2x: zero cutoffs, visible SH
proposals.test: Bee and shop, 2560x1440, 2 reversed trials; validate frozen settings on 16.18M and 32.37M Lublin inputs
proposals.primary_metric: Pooled median completed moving-frame latency, separately per scene
guardrails: Minimum foreground PSNR no more than 0.5 dB below exact LOD
Moving p95 no more than 20 percent worse
Same input count, SH terms, paths, resolution and GPU sort
proposals.rejection_rule: Do not promote as a default without at least 5 percent median gain and both quality and tail guards passing on selection and larger tests.
failure_modes: Many individually weak splats jointly cover an opaque surface
proposals.cost: One bounded local batch; no paid services; under 100 GB of derived artifacts
proposals.boundary: Single Apple M5 Max device and fixed paths

score_reasons.evidence_strength: Default bundle was faster but unisolated.
score_reasons.expected_impact: Saves work before SH, sorting and draw.

proposals.title: PC fine culling plus visible SH
proposals.hypothesis: PC's additional two-pixel cutoff accelerates LOD while retaining its measured quality.
proposals.mechanism: Set minPixelSize=2 and minContribution=3 with the existing visible-only SH projector.
proposals.interaction: Footprint and opacity signals reject different splats; evaluating SH after both avoids paying for discarded colors.
proposals.baseline: Rebased exact LOD 2x; also compare P1 to isolate footprint cutoff
proposals.test: Same frozen paired bee/shop and larger-city protocol as P1
proposals.primary_metric: Pooled median completed moving-frame latency, separately per scene
guardrails: Minimum foreground PSNR within 0.5 dB of exact LOD
Moving p95 within 20 percent of exact LOD
proposals.rejection_rule: Promote only with at least 5 percent median gain and all guards passing; retain failed-quality settings only as explicit opt-in.
failure_modes: Two-pixel cutoff can erase dense fur or thin details, as suggested by prior bee default error
proposals.boundary: Fixed full-resolution views on one device

score_reasons.evidence_strength: Prior default comparison exposed both speed and quality differences.
score_reasons.information_gain: Tests whether default footprint policy fits merged splats.

proposals.title: PC culling and cached SH
proposals.hypothesis: Reusing PC's color work buffer is cheaper than evaluating visible SH every moving frame.
proposals.mechanism: Use PC-default fine culling, disable fused visible SH, and keep PC colorUpdateAngle=10 with native work-buffer updates.
proposals.interaction: Culling cuts raster work while cached color avoids repeated SH when the camera remains inside the update cone.
proposals.baseline: P2 isolates SH schedule; exact LOD remains the quality guard
proposals.test: Same protocol, including full camera translation and rotation; SH0 city inputs cannot establish an SH-reuse benefit
proposals.primary_metric: Pooled median completed moving-frame latency, separately per scene
guardrails: Foreground PSNR within 0.5 dB of exact LOD
Moving p95 within 20 percent of exact LOD
Fresh globally sorted geometry every frame
proposals.rejection_rule: Do not promote if color refresh spikes erase median gains or either quality guard fails.
failure_modes: Full resident-bank color updates cost more than visible-only SH
proposals.cost: Same bounded local batch; no extra color buffers
proposals.boundary: Native PC whole-bank caching may be unsuitable inside large chunks

score_reasons.evidence_strength: Mechanism available but not independently tested in our renderer.
score_reasons.information_gain: Resolves whether our visible-SH choice was useful.

protocol.baseline: Stock upstream main d753e98c70d67b755754c614f383d215cacbbd63, release/minified build; exact LOD on the same base is the optimization control
protocol.selection_data: Frozen Bee and Ekotori full scans and paths from packages/splat-lod/benchmark/scenes.mjs
protocol.holdout_policy: Freeze all three stock-setting candidates and guards before reading large-city timing or image-error results. Camera/setup preflights are not selection evidence. Report every variant, including regressions.
protocol.primary_metric: Median completed moving-frame latency pooled across two reversed-order trials, separately per scene
guardrails: 0.5 dB maximum reduction in minimum foreground PSNR from exact LOD
20 percent maximum moving p95 regression from exact LOD
All available source SH, global current-view GPU sorting, identical physical 2560x1440 resolution
protocol.promotion_rule: A default needs at least 5 percent moving-median improvement with both guards passing in selection and larger-input validation. Otherwise keep exact as default and expose useful lossy profiles explicitly.
protocol.failure_handling: Retain failures and errors; no best-run picking. One fresh closed browser tab per case. Incomplete or hidden-tab measurements are invalid, not slow-renderer results. If rerunning a scene after setup repair, rerun all of its modes in prescribed order.
protocol.budget: One three-proposal selection batch, then the same fixed variants on two larger inputs; 7 configurations x 4 inputs x 2 trials, 90 static and 90 moving frames each. Under 100 GB disk, no paid services. Stop after reporting that batch; record but do not automatically execute a fresh next frontier.
